page_title: Meridian — the open-source Arc browser alternative

sources.entry: Meridian - Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium with spaces, pinned tabs, a command bar, one-click Arc and Chrome import, and a built-in MCP server for AI agents. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Undermove/meridian-browser) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Meridian
summary.one_liner: Meridian is an open-source, Chromium-based browser for macOS and Windows that recreates the Arc browser's spaces, pinned tabs, split view and command bar, with one-click Arc import.
use_cases: Switching from Arc to another browser while keeping spaces and logins
Organising work and personal browsing into separate spaces
Viewing two pages side by side in one window
Using an AI assistant on the current web page
Blocking ads and trackers without installing extensions
summary.what_it_does: Meridian is a Chromium-based browser that offers Arc-style spaces with their own colours and logins, a sidebar with pinned tabs and folders, and a command bar. Split view lets two pages sit side by side, and Peek opens links in a quick preview instead of a new tab. A one-click import moves Arc spaces, pinned tabs, favorites, cookies, saved passwords, history and extensions over on first launch. The page also describes built-in ad and tracker blocking, automatic archiving of tabs left untouched, and AI features that use a Claude API key, GitHub Copilot or a local model. Chrome Web Store extensions are stated to work.
notable: Open source under the MIT license, with no subscription or account required
One-click import of Arc spaces, pinned tabs, logins and extensions
Built on Chromium so Chrome Web Store extensions work
AI features can use a Claude API key, GitHub Copilot or a free local model
caveats: Meridian 0.6 requires a Mac with Apple silicon
Linux build is not out yet
Not code-signed with Apple or Microsoft certificates, so macOS and Windows show security warnings on install
On Windows, Arc must be quit before importing, and Arc extensions do not import yet
